name: Invite Me In
source:
Walking home alone one night, you meet an injured stranger in need of help. So you do what you’d hope anyone else would do for you in that situation… you invite him in… 

[From [url=https://squidcolas.itch.io/invite-me-in]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天夜里，你独自步行回家，遇见一位受了伤、需要帮助的陌生人。于是，你做了自己身处那种境地时也希望别人做的事……请他进了家门……

[摘自[url=https://squidcolas.itch.io/invite-me-in]itch.io[/url]]
